item.title: 50/50 Bachata & Salsa on Thursdays — Thu Oct 8, 7:00 PM — Neruda’s Brunswick
item.description:
Spring has sprung! Let’s dance! Showy Dance Melbourne & Neruda Brunswick joined forces to bring a night for Bachata & Salsa class + a Social dance night! Every Thursday from 7 pm. 7 pm: Bachata class. 8 pm: Salsa class. 9 pm: Social night. After the 2 classes finished, we will continue the night with Social dance. Neruda Brunswick is a Latino American restaurant located in Brunswick. Address: 66 Breese St, Brunswick. Both of our classes will be Open level. Cost of the class: 1 class $20.- 2 classes $30.- After the classes you can stay for the Social night to practice the steps that you learnt in class or just mingle enjoying the vibes and the Latin atmosphere of Neruda Brunswick. Any question: Just give us a call: 0431 037 786. email: showydancemelbourne@gmail.com See you on the dance floor!! …….

item.title: Pontoon Salsa Thursdays — Thu Oct 8, 7:30 PM — Pontoon Bar Darling Harbour
item.description: Welcome to Pontoon Salsa Thursdays! Get ready to spice up your Thursday nights with the hottest Latin dance party in town! Experience required. Drink Specials: $7.50 Coronas and $25 Sangria jugs to share with friends! $10 Pizzas: Refuel with mouthwatering pizzas to keep you energised all night. Music rotation: 2 x Salsa, 2 x Bachata, and 1 x Latino anthem. Curated Music: Our DJs will keep the dance floor moving with specially selected Salsa and Bachata for dancers. Pontoon Bar offers stunning harbor views, a vibrant atmosphere, and friendly staff to ensure you have an unforgettable experience. This event is for anyone who loves Latin music and dance, whether you’re a seasoned pro or just looking to have fun and meet new people. Celebrating a special occasion? We’ve got you cover

item.title: Salsa Thursdays at Time Out Market — Thu Oct 8, 7:00 PM — Time Out Market New York
item.description:
Join us for one of NYC’s best free salsa nights and turn your Thursday into a dance-floor celebration.
Get your salsa on every Thursday night at Time Out Market New York! Head up to the fifth floor for an electrifying evening of rhythm, movement, and Latin vibes. Whether you’re a total beginner or a seasoned dancer, this is your weekly excuse to move, sweat, and smile. Starting at 7:30 PM, renowned instructor Marlene Veras will guide you through the steps, breaking down the fundamentals so you feel confident on the dance floor. The night is powered by infectious beats from DJ Ray Suave, with live percussion by Jessica La Timbalera, setting the stage for a high-energy salsa experience. After the lesson, the floor opens up for a full-on salsa dance party until 10 PM. Bring a partner or come solo—everyone’s welcome.
Source: Go Latin Dance

item.title: Connect 4: A Conversation Workshop with GenWell — Tue Oct 13, 6:00 PM — Toronto Reference Library
item.description: Connect4 Workshop with GenWell A playful, no-pressure challenge that turns strangers into new connections — one quick conversation at a time. This lighthearted pre-show activity invites you to join our “social” experiment and step out of your comfort zone into a few unexpected conversations. Inspired by our evening's speakers, Dr. Nick Epley and Dr. Gillian Sandstrom, and in partnership with GenWell, Canada's Human Connection Movement, we're turning the simple act of talking to someone new into a game — equal parts curiosity, fun, and connection. No scripts, no pressure — just a chance to discover how easy (and rewarding) it can be to connect with people you don't already know.
